title: Bear and Game
statementMd:
Bear Limak likes watching sports on TV. He is going to watch a game today. The game lasts $90$ minutes and there are no breaks.

Each minute can be either interesting or boring. If $15$ consecutive minutes are boring then Limak immediately turns TV off.

You know that there will be $*n*$ interesting minutes $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$. Your task is to calculate for how many minutes Limak will watch the game.

## Input

The first line of the input contains one integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 90$) — the number of interesting minutes.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{1} < *t*_{2} < ... *t*_{*n*} ≤ 90$), given in the increasing order.

## Output

Print the number of minutes Limak will watch the game.

## Note

In the first sample, minutes $21, 22, ..., 35$ are all boring and thus Limak will turn TV off immediately after the $35$-th minute. So, he would watch the game for $35$ minutes.

In the second sample, the first $15$ minutes are boring.

In the third sample, there are no consecutive $15$ boring minutes. So, Limak will watch the whole game.
statementZhMd:
Limak 喜欢在电视上观看体育比赛。今天他打算观看一场比赛。比赛持续 $90$ 分钟，期间没有休息。

每一分钟都可能是有趣的，也可能是无聊的。如果连续 $15$ 分钟都很无聊，Limak 就会立即关掉电视。

你知道比赛中会有 $*n*$ 个有趣的时刻，分别是第 $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$ 分钟。你的任务是计算 Limak 会观看这场比赛多少分钟。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 90$）——有趣分钟的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{1} < *t*_{2} < ... *t*_{*n*} ≤ 90$），这些整数按递增顺序给出。

## 输出格式

输出 Limak 会观看比赛的分钟数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第 $21, 22, ..., 35$ 分钟全部是无聊的，因此 Limak 会在第 $35$ 分钟结束后立即关掉电视。所以，他会观看比赛 $35$ 分钟。

在第二个样例中，前 $15$ 分钟都是无聊的。

在第三个样例中，不存在连续 $15$ 分钟无聊的情况。因此，Limak 会观看完整场比赛。
